title: Test import-time logging in a subprocess with MLFLOW_CONFIGURE_LOGGING=0 and host-managed logging
answers: how to test that importing an mlflow module stays quiet under custom logging
subprocess regression test for MLflow logging configuration
why does my logging test not see mlflow's log config
test host-managed root logging in mlflow
body:
Import-time logging behavior can only be checked in a fresh interpreter, since the test process has already imported mlflow.
Run `sys.executable -c <code>` via subprocess.run with capture_output=True, text=True, check=True.
In the code string, call logging.basicConfig(level=logging.WARNING) before importing the module under test, so the host owns logging.
Build env from os.environ.copy(), pop MLFLOW_LOGGING_CONFIGURE_LOGGING, and set MLFLOW_CONFIGURE_LOGGING="0" so MLflow does not reconfigure the root logger.
Assert on result.stderr: the expected message appears exactly once, and the suppressed variant string is absent. Also trigger an ordinary warning in the same subprocess to prove visibility is preserved.
applies: Tests in tests/types/ or elsewhere that verify MLflow import-time log or warning output.
says: Importing the package overwrites existing application logging settings and produces unexpected console warnings.
Spurious schema inference warning messages appear in terminal logs during module startup.
Respect host logging configurations rather than resetting the root logger on startup.
Terminal output shows duplicate log entries when launching scripts with custom logging.
search: Testing import-time logging and warning output requires executing a fresh interpreter subprocess with host-managed logging. The test builds an environment popping MLFLOW_LOGGING_CONFIGURE_LOGGING and setting MLFLOW_CONFIGURE_LOGGING='0', calling logging.basicConfig before importing the module under test in tests/types/. Assertions on standard error check that expected messages appear once while suppressed variants are absent, alongside triggering an ordinary warning to verify visibility.
